dct_description_sm:
see also Glen Vowell Band Sik-e-Dakh 2 and Gitanmaax Band Anlaw 4 Reserves, 1900_2024
(https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/NVYPED)

Georeferenced map of Kispiox Band reserves Agwedin 3 and Kispiox 1 in and surrounding the village of Kispiox, and along the Kispiox and Skeena Rivers clipped from original Plan of the Kispaiax [Kispiox] Indian Reserves, Cassiar District (https://doi.org/10.58066/0pk0-vm16). Land cover and features include types of trees and soil, a mission, hay fields, Kis-Pai-Ax [Kispiox] village, Kispaiax River, [Kispiox River] Shegunia River and a road from Hazelton and to Kulldaw.
